versions.changelog:
AI Polo Shirt Designer 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a tool for generating custom polo shirt designs for print/manufacturing on demand.
- Supports structured clothing parameters, natural language prompts, reference images, customized text, and logo placement.
- Generates multi-view design images and interactive 3D clothing previews.
- Includes API reference for design draft generation and quick start instructions.
- Integrates with the Craftsman Agent Manufacturing Platform for supplier access.
